items.statement: Correct complete objects, conserved stoichiometry, declared states and energy reference. Validate actual atom maps and raw calculation identity before dependent scores. Use neutral singlet 6,7-dimethyl-2-(pyridin-2-yl)quinoxaline, C15H13N3, from CCDC2433822. Cis/trans is the mapped N1-C1-C2-N2 torsion; preserve deposited labels. Primary gas phase and acetonitrile continuum at 298.15 K, consistent 1 M molecular convention for solution. Six bonds are exactly those in experimental_bonds.json; seven SI or 33 CIF bond sets must not enter this RMSE.
